findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0364: Exported And Unprotected Activities That Expose Sensitive Functionality
findings.explanation:
Exported MainActivity (no permission) takes KEY_INTERNAL_USER_ID from any caller's extras, switches the active account and forwards all extras to ChatActivity, which honours KEY_FROM_NOTIFICATION_START_CALL to start a call (mic/camera) and KEY_SHARED_FILE_PATHS to stage uploads, so a third-party app can start a call in a room it chooses. Ward's analyzer said: Exported activities without a permission. Ward lists them; check whether each one exposes sensitive functionality or trusts its intent's data.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/activities/MainActivity.kt:273: All caller-supplied extras forwarded to ChatActivity.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/chat/ChatActivity.kt:1292: Caller-controlled flag that auto-starts a call.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/chat/ChatActivity.kt:1552: Call started without user action.
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:109: activity .activities.MainActivity; exported: yes (android:exported is set); deep link schemes: content, file, nextcloudtalk
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:167: activity .conversationlist.ConversationsListActivity; exported: yes (android:exported is set)

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0327: References to APIs for Event-Bound Biometric Authentication
findings.explanation:
The app-lock unlock is decided in onAuthenticationSucceeded (finish()) and falls back to authenticate() without a CryptoObject when none is ready; a Keystore key with setUserAuthenticationRequired(true) exists but protects no data, so the lock is event-bound in practice. The strict test conditions are not both met; whether this counts needs a human call.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/lock/LockedActivity.kt:121: BiometricPrompt used without a CryptoObject.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0330: References to APIs for Keys used in Biometric Authentication with Extended Validity Duration
findings.explanation:
The app-lock Keystore key is created with setUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds set to the user's screen-lock timeout (>0), so it stays usable after authentication.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/utils/SecurityUtils.java:97: Validity duration from the lock timeout.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0212: Use of Hardcoded Cryptographic Keys in Code
findings.explanation:
The SQLCipher passphrase for the Room database (which stores account tokens) is a hardcoded string resource shipped in the APK, so anyone with the APK or source can decrypt the database.
app/src/main/res/values/setup.xml:11: Database encryption key hardcoded as a string resource.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/data/source/local/TalkDatabase.kt:147: The hardcoded resource is used as the SQLCipher passphrase.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0304: References to Sensitive Data Unencrypted via Android Room Database
findings.explanation:
The Room database holds account tokens (UserEntity.token) and chat data; it is SQLCipher-encrypted but with a key hardcoded in the APK, so the data is effectively unprotected.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/data/user/model/UserEntity.kt:38: Account token stored as a Room column.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/data/source/local/TalkDatabase.kt:147: Database passphrase comes from a hardcoded resource.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0306: References to Sensitive Data Stored Unencrypted via Android Room DB
findings.explanation:
Same finding as MASTG-TEST-0304: tokens in the Room DB protected only by a hardcoded SQLCipher key.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/data/user/model/UserEntity.kt:38: Account token stored as a Room column.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/data/source/local/TalkDatabase.kt:147: Database passphrase comes from a hardcoded resource.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0233: Hardcoded HTTP URLs
findings.explanation:
When HTTPS fails during server setup the app offers to retry over plain http:// and then uses that base URL for all API traffic; cleartext is allowed by the network security config.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/account/ServerSelectionActivity.kt:322: Server check retried over http://.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/account/data/LoginRepository.kt:259: http:// accepted as account protocol.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0235: Android App Configurations Allowing Cleartext Traffic
findings.explanation:
The network security config's base-config permits cleartext traffic for every domain.
app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:10: base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0282: Unsafe Custom Trust Evaluation
findings.explanation:
The custom X509TrustManager first uses the system trust manager, but when it rejects the chain it asks the user and accepts any certificate the user approves for that host (stored in a local keystore), loosening trust for self-signed/untrusted certs.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/utils/ssl/TrustManager.java:144: On system validation failure the user is asked to trust the cert.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/utils/ssl/TrustManager.java:150: User-approved cert is accepted.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0285: Outdated Android Version Allowing Trust in User-Provided CAs
findings.explanation:
The network security config trusts user-installed CAs outside debug-overrides, so anyone who can install a certificate on the device can read the app's TLS traffic.
app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:14: base-config trusts user-installed CAs

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0372: Implicit Intents Used for Internal App Communication
findings.explanation:
The PiP mute/unmute action is sent as an implicit broadcast (action only, no package/component) for app-internal communication; any app can register a receiver for that action and receive it.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/activities/CallActivity.kt:3556: Implicit internal broadcast intent wrapped in a PendingIntent.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0381: References to Insecure PendingIntent Creation
findings.explanation:
The PiP PendingIntent uses an implicit base intent, and on API < 31 (minSdk 26) it is created with flags 0, i.e. mutable.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/activities/CallActivity.kt:3556: Implicit base intent for PendingIntent.getBroadcast.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0315: Sensitive Data Exposed via Notifications
findings.explanation:
minSdk 26; message notifications show sender/subject and message text with default visibility (no VISIBILITY_PRIVATE or public version). Showing chat previews is the app's feature; whether message content counts as sensitive here needs a human decision.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/jobs/NotificationWorker.kt:755: Message text set as notification content.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0216: Sensitive Data Not Excluded From Backup
findings.explanation:
allowBackup is true and the referenced backup rules file is empty (no exclude), so the database with account tokens and the shared preferences (push token etc.) are included in backups; no dataExtractionRules is declared. Ward's analyzer said: Backup is on with backup rules. Check that the rules exclude credentials, tokens and other sensitive files.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0231: References to Logging APIs
findings.explanation:
The push registration logs the full push token to logcat with Log.d, and the release build has no rule stripping Log calls. Other log calls reviewed log room tokens/ids, not credentials; the HTTP logger redacts Authorization and is opt-in.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/utils/PushUtils.kt:195: Push token written to logcat.

findings.explanation:

Ward's analyzer said: Backup is on with backup rules. Check that the rules exclude credentials, tokens and other sensitive files.
